## Objective

What decision or uncertainty should this spike resolve?

## Context

Summarize the current evidence and why investigation is needed.

## Expected Outcome

Define the evidence, comparison, prototype, or recommendation to deliver.

## Constraints

State the time box, non-goals, allowed experiments, and applicable approval gates.

## Dependencies

List prerequisite decisions, data, tools, or external inputs.

## References

Link relevant Issues, documentation, research, or prior decisions.
